props.text: Regular house cleaners in Manchester you can rely on

Cleaniq Services provides regular house cleaning in Manchester and across Greater Manchester. Our local house cleaners visit every week, every fortnight or once a month, and follow the same checklist on every visit, so your home stays clean without you having to think about it.

A regular cleaner is one of the simplest ways to get your evenings and weekends back. Instead of catching up on housework, you come home to clean floors, fresh bathrooms and a tidy kitchen. You choose the day, the arrival time and how many hours each visit lasts when you book, and your future visits are scheduled for you.

Book your regular house cleaning online in a few minutes or call us on [07846 726428](tel:+447846726428). Need a bigger refresh first? Start with a [deep clean](/service/deep-cleaning-manchester), keep it that way with regular visits, and add [oven cleaning](/service/oven-cleaning-manchester) or [carpet cleaning](/service/carpet-cleaning-manchester) whenever you need it.

props.text: Frequently Asked Questions: Regular House Cleaning Manchester

items.q: How much does regular house cleaning cost in Manchester?
items.a: Regular house cleaning is charged by the hour. The current rate is shown at the top of this page and comes straight from our booking system. You choose how many hours each visit lasts when you book.

items.q: How often can I book a regular cleaner?
items.a: Weekly, fortnightly or monthly. Choose the frequency, day and arrival time when you book, and your future visits are scheduled for you.

items.q: Do I need to be home while the house cleaner is there?
items.a: No. Many customers leave a key or entry code — just add access notes when you book.

items.q: Do your cleaners bring cleaning products?
items.a: You choose: use your own supplies, or we bring eco-friendly cleaning products and equipment for £10 per visit.

items.q: What if I'm not happy with a clean?
items.a: Tell us within 48 hours and we'll send a cleaner back to re-clean anything that wasn't right, free of charge.

items.q: Where do you have house cleaners near me?
items.a: We clean homes across Manchester and Greater Manchester, including Manchester City Centre, Salford, Trafford, Stockport, Didsbury, Chorlton, Bolton, Bury, Oldham, Rochdale, Tameside and Wigan.

items.q: What does a regular house clean include?
items.a: Every regular visit covers the kitchen, bathrooms, bedrooms, living areas, stairs and hallways: surfaces wiped, the outside of appliances cleaned, toilets and bathrooms cleaned, dusting, vacuuming, mopping and bins emptied. The full regular house cleaning checklist is on this page.

items.q: Will I have the same cleaner every time?
items.a: Regular cleans have a regular cleaner, so you see the same person on each visit wherever possible.

items.q: When am I charged for regular cleans?
items.a: Each visit is charged 24 hours before it takes place, using the card you saved when you booked your first visit.

items.q: Can I pause or cancel my regular cleaning?
items.a: Yes. Contact us to pause or cancel your regular cleans. Please see our terms and conditions for notice periods and any fees.

items.q: How many hours do I need for each visit?
items.a: It depends on the size of your home and how much needs doing. You choose the number of hours when you book. If you're not sure, call us on 07846 726428 and we'll help you decide.

items.q: Do you clean homes with pets?
items.a: Yes. Just let us know about any pets when you book, so your cleaner knows what to expect.
